verdicts.reason: Both use the same weak layout. The headline is small and isolated top-left above a large empty area on the left-middle. The shoe sits off to the right. The LIMITED badge has drifted to the far bottom-right, away from the headline it belongs with, and the bottom row reads as three disconnected fragments. A keeps symmetric margins of about 75px on each side, so the copy and badge frame the canvas evenly. B pushes the headline and copy to about 25px from the left edge while the badge stays about 77px from the right, which leaves the layout lopsided and cramped against the left edge.
